name: BlocksXR
summary:
Step into the spatial tabletop of BlocksXR — a stylized 9-mode 3D diorama puzzle and block-building suite crafted for Meta Quest!

9 COMPLETE GAME MODES IN ONE DIORAMA
• BlockOut3D — Rotate and drop 3D polyominoes to clear full horizontal layers inside the well.
• Octris — Multi-axis spatial block-clearing challenge.
• Block2048 — Slide, roll, and merge 3D number cubes all the way to 2048.
• BlockAttack — Fast-paced arcade block clearing under pressure.
• BlockBuilder — Freeform 3D voxel and block sandbox.
